newsitem.title: FINLAND: PM LIPPONEN REPEATS PLEDGE TO CONTROL PUBLIC DEBT.
newsitem.headline: PM LIPPONEN REPEATS PLEDGE TO CONTROL PUBLIC DEBT.

text.p: Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen on Wednesday repeated the government's pledge to keep Finland's public sector debt under control and to reduce its burden on the national economy.

"The government remains committed to keeping public debt under control and to reduce the burden it places on the national economy," Lipponen said in Turku in the text of a speech prepared for delivery at a seminar for municipal leaders.
Finland's gross public debt in relation to GDP is forecast by the EU Commission to rise to 59.2 percent of GDP this year from 58.7 percent in 1996, but fall to 58.6 percent in 1998.
